localRule.DE.augsburg.help: The Augsburg Peace Festival on 8 August is a public holiday only in the city of Augsburg (Bavarian Public Holidays Act). Turn it on if it applies to you.
localRule.DE.assumption: Assumption Day (municipality with a mostly Catholic population)
localRule.DE.assumption.help: Assumption Day on 15 August is a public holiday in Bavaria only in municipalities with a mostly Catholic population. The Bavarian State Office for Statistics decides which ones. Turn it on if it applies to your municipality.
localRule.DE.corpusChristi.help: Corpus Christi is a public holiday in Saxony and Thuringia only in certain municipalities. Turn it on if it applies to your municipality.
